import pandas as pd

# Read source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_44/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_44/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_44/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_44/training_3.csv", index_col=0)

# Concatenate all source dataframes (UNION)
df = pd.concat([df0, df1, df2, df3], ignore_index=True)

# The target schema is:
# ['org_salary_period': string, 'title': integer, 'company': integer, 'location': integer, 'summary': integer,
#  'salary': integer, 'href': integer, 'rate': integer, 'reviews': integer]

# The intermediate_step1.csv (and thus df) already has these columns but with numeric values that are floats or strings.
# We need to ensure:
# - org_salary_period is string
# - all other columns are integers
# - reviews column may contain commas, convert to int
# - rate column may be float, convert to int by rounding or truncation
# - salary may be float, convert to int by rounding or truncation
# - href column is integer (already numeric in intermediate)
# - title, company, location, summary are integers

# Clean and convert columns accordingly

# Convert org_salary_period to string (should already be string)
df['org_salary_period'] = df['org_salary_period'].astype(str)

# Clean 'reviews' column: remove commas and convert to int
df['reviews'] = df['reviews'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
df['reviews'] = pd.to_numeric(df['reviews'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# Convert all other columns except org_salary_period to integers
int_columns = ['title', 'company', 'location', 'summary', 'salary', 'href', 'rate']
for col in int_columns:
    # Convert to numeric first (in case of strings), then to int
    df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = ['org_salary_period', 'title', 'company', 'location', 'summary', 'salary', 'href', 'rate', 'reviews']
Target4_44 = df[target_columns]

# Write the final dataframe to the target CSV file without the index
Target4_44.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_44/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
